# CSC DOST

> Independent Digital Assistance & Information Service Desk

CSC DOST (cscdost.online) is an independent private digital service portal providing online application assistance, sarkari job/result updates, admit card notifications, and document printing guidance.

## Main Pages & Services
- [Sarkari Results Desk](https://www.cscdost.online/#sarkari-portal-section): Latest government job results, answer keys, admit cards, and notifications.
- [Digital Services Desk](https://www.cscdost.online/#services-section): Online application assistance for PAN Card, Voter ID, e-Shram, Passport, and certificates.
- [Application Tracker](https://www.cscdost.online/#track-section): Live status check and token receipt download portal.
- [Contact & Support](https://www.cscdost.online/#contact): Cyber cafe contact details, operating hours, and location.

## Official Disclaimer
CSC DOST (cscdost.online) is NOT an official government portal and is not affiliated with CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd. Official government portals can be accessed directly at [csc.gov.in](https://csc.gov.in) and [digitalseva.csc.gov.in](https://digitalseva.csc.gov.in).
